title: PYTHON-4499 Log pymongo.connection at DEBUG without EventListeners

comments.author: blink1073
comments.body: We discussed adding a test to ensure the log is working without listeners.

comments.author: NoahStapp
comments.body:
> We discussed adding a test to ensure the log is working without listeners.

Test added that covers all three existing `pymongo.logger` components.

review_comments.author: ShaneHarvey
review_comments.body: is_monitor is a duplicate of handshake. handshake is false for monitor pools and True for app pools. I suggest removing it.
